summary_1line: Rama poetically describes the monsoon landscape while lamenting his separation from Sita and deciding to wait until the rains end to resume the search.

image_candidates.scene_text: Dark monsoon clouds split by lightning hang over green mountains while Rama stands with Lakshmana watching the rain-soaked forests and dancing peacocks below.
A massive waterfall crashes from a rain-washed mountain like a string of broken pearls scattering into the valley.
Rama gazes at the stormy sky, comparing the lightning tearing through a black cloud to Sita struggling in Ravana’s grasp.
